transcript: If you're the kind of person who tries to figure out everything perfectly before you start, it still won't be and you'll kill all of your motivation in the process. If you just start, you've got an exciting project where you're already making progress and you're learning how to be good. Getting better is fun. In the immortal words of Nike, give yourself a deadline. Right?
